cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Because I need help, not a second direction.
